cells.gaps: No share of returns filed online is held; the mandate is dated March 2022 and is held from an IMF report published in April 2024.
cells.note: An IMF report of April 2024 says electronic filing on Kontaktu has been mandatory for all large and medium taxpayers since March 2022 (GNB-005), a source inside three years stating the mandate in force. O Democrata GB says in July 2024 that Kontaktu takes returns and payment by bank transfer and mobile money (GNB-001, GNB-002).
